position_policy: Signal placement uses the reference CSV signal coordinate. A008 points are reserved for timing/provenance only.
straight_signal_policy: Straight signals control only mainline through/same-direction connections at the CSV stopline; side-road/intersection phases are not inferred.
lane_change_boundary_policy: Lane Change Point boundaries are segmentation/lane-change artifacts and are not signalized.

terminal_egress_tuning.policy: Map-boundary egress: Seoul Station target sits immediately after a large terminal junction, so the final through movement receives dominant green to avoid artificial end-of-map delay.

policy.selection: Named CSV signal boundaries on the B4 firetruck route are installed at the reference CSV signal coordinates. A008 is not used for signal placement.
policy.s1_s2_no_phase_policy: A shared named boundary without CSV phase is still treated as a conservative signal candidate.
policy.s1_start_policy: S1:start is forced as a physical Sindang Station vehicle TLS and moved to the CSV Sindang Station signal coordinate.
policy.s22_end_policy: S22:end is represented by the existing Seoul Station terminal TLS and moved/reported at the CSV Seoul Station Rotary signal coordinate.
policy.mainline_priority: Intersection signals use mainline-dominant phases; straight signals use mainline-only green/yellow/red phases.
policy.terminal_egress: The final Seoul Station-front route movement is a map-boundary egress and is tuned separately from CSV-created TLS.
